# Alexandre Beguel

> Alexandre Beguel is an Agentic AI Architect and external Chief AI Officer (CAIO) based in Paris who builds production GenAI that can be measured, audited and controlled.

His focus is LLMOps, LLM FinOps, evaluation and evidence-first AI governance (EU AI Act, ISO/IEC 42001, NIST AI RMF). He is the founder of Digitalizor and has 20 years of experience across IT, data and AI. He works in French (native), English and Spanish. Engagements take GenAI from scoping to production for mid-sized companies, startups and e-commerce businesses: scoping and architecture, measurable production, governance and compliance, external CAIO and training.

## Open-source projects

- [grafana-llmops-forge](https://github.com/alebgl77/grafana-llmops-forge): discovers available telemetry (OTel GenAI, LiteLLM, vLLM/TGI, DCGM), then generates and deploys seven dashboards for FinOps, agents, quality and governance. Automated query and contract checks run in E2E CI on Grafana 9.5 to 13.2. Generated queries are checked against a real Prometheus in CI. Rendering capture and optional DOM prechecks prepare a separate, optional human or vision-agent semantic visual review
- [openspanguard](https://github.com/alebgl77/openspanguard): OTLP enrichment gateway that evaluates completed generation spans and exposes evaluation coverage next to quality scores, so a good average cannot hide unevaluated traffic
- [dsh-plugin-otel-genai](https://github.com/alebgl77/dsh-plugin-otel-genai): content-free OpenTelemetry GenAI token and latency metrics for DeepSeek Harness, ready for the grafana-llmops-forge dashboards
- [open-shadow-ai](https://github.com/alebgl77/open-shadow-ai): self-hosted Shadow AI discovery that correlates network, endpoint and identity signals, with an explicit evidence level per finding; presence is never reported as usage
- [ftp-deploy-mcp](https://github.com/alebgl77/ftp-deploy-mcp): MCP deployment server for FTP, FTPS and SFTP with local-root confinement and SFTP host-key pinning. Enabling stateDir adds the durable workflow: SHA-256-verified staged promotion, explicit MCP confirmation, resume and conservative rollback of acknowledged changes. Version 0.3.2 is published on npm and the Official MCP Registry
- [tierdecay](https://github.com/alebgl77/tierdecay): per-repo learning layer for AI coding routers that moves recurring task classes to a cheaper tier after statistically confirmed successes. In a controlled pilot, the fast tier without a playbook cost 0.657x frontier cost per task at warm-cache prices (95% interval 0.626 to 0.694; nine paired tasks, 36 runs overall). A protocol replay modeled 24% lower cost than always-frontier, including distillation; this is a different comparison from the fast-tier ratio
- [claude-inc](https://github.com/alebgl77/claude-inc): Claude Code plugin that runs a project as a virtual company, with bounded review loops and SHA-256 records of submitted artifacts. Unreleased source 1.6.0-dev.0 has peer CEO, CTO and CAIO, nine departments and 64 skill manuals. Published v1.5.1 has peer CEO/CTO, eight departments and 54 manuals
- [harnessmeter](https://github.com/alebgl77/harnessmeter): estimates the token footprint of instructions and skills, offline by default. Published npm 0.3.0 supports Claude Code session analysis and reviewable demotion patches. Unreleased source adds Codex inventories, baselines and CI budgets. Optional T2 review for Claude-profile audits sends claim text and session counts through an agent CLI to its model provider, using its quota

## Contributions

- [AgentShield #123](https://github.com/affaan-m/agentshield/pull/123): merged; the scanner now discovers and classifies root .mcp.json files so MCP configurations reach the security rules
- [LibreChat #15046](https://github.com/LibreChat-AI/LibreChat/pull/15046): merged documentation fix; made CLAUDE.md portable and restored CLAUDE.md/AGENTS.md parity for auth-cache guidance
- [Claude SEO #285](https://github.com/AgriciDaniel/claude-seo/pull/285): improved JSON-LD detection and removed template-expression false positives; landed in v2.3.0 with authorship preserved
- [Grafana plugin-tools #2841](https://github.com/grafana/plugin-tools/pull/2841): merged; signed-commit contributor guidance
- [Grafana plugin-tools #2830](https://github.com/grafana/plugin-tools/pull/2830): merged; Node 24 .nvmrc scaffold update
- [OpenTelemetry GenAI semantic conventions #516](https://github.com/open-telemetry/semantic-conventions-genai/pull/516): in review; recording token usage on fetch_response spans
- [LangChain OpenWiki #818](https://github.com/langchain-ai/openwiki/pull/818): draft; Mistral provider support, with live Mistral validation still pending
